sourceNotes.rawContent:
Add a touch of vintage elegance to your jewellery collection with this Vintage Anti-Tarnish Gold Bracelet Watch, featuring a beautiful emerald green dial and a unique pearl-detail chain bracelet. The elegant combination of gold, green and pearl accents creates a luxurious, feminine look that stands out effortlessly.
Designed with a jewellery-inspired bracelet and anti-tarnish finish, this watch is perfect for anyone who loves statement accessories with a classic vintage charm. The unique leaf-shaped dial and delicate pearl detailing make it a beautiful choice for both everyday styling and special occasions.
Product Highlights
- ✨ Vintage-inspired jewellery watch
- 💛 Anti-tarnish gold-tone finish
- 💚 Elegant emerald green dial
- 🤍 Pearl-detail bracelet design
- 🌿 Unique leaf-shaped dial
- ⌚ Quartz movement
- 🔗 Stylish statement chain bracelet
- 💎 Combines the look of a watch with a jewellery accessory
- 👗 Perfect for ethnic and western outfits
- 🎁 Beautiful gifting option for women
Perfect For
Festive occasions, parties, date nights, weddings, office wear, casual outings and everyday styling.
Care Tip: Keep away from perfumes, water, excessive sweat and harsh chemicals. Store in a dry place when not in use to help maintain the finish.
